runs.name: Federated learning run (5% data)
runs.note: Matches Tanvir's W&B screenshot panel 'train_loss' (CS-LSTM FedAvg, 5% data, 155 steps, 5 rounds). Clients sequential (3 logged points each per round); global logged once per round.

runs.name: Full 12 round run
runs.note: Standard FL, BATraj (no behavior graph), 12 rounds x 10 clients. Clients train sequentially within a round (client_k block offset 232 steps); per-batch loss logged every N batches. global = mean client train loss per round, logged at end of each round. Loss switches MSE->NLL partway (negative values possible).

runs.name: polar-fog-9
runs.note: TAPPFL-BATraj lambda=0.5, 12 rounds. No client_*/train_loss: client_k = client_k/total_loss (utility + lambda*privacy); client_k/priv_loss and client_k/jsd_loss also included. global = global/avg_train_loss (avg total loss), plus global/avg_priv_loss, avg_jsd_loss.
